quote: On October 28, 2025, we signed a new definitive agreement with OpenAI that extends our partnership and continues to build on our shared vision to advance artificial intelligence responsibly and make its benefits broadly accessible. Additionally, OpenAI has formed a public benefit corporation ("PBC") and completed a recapitalization. As a result of the recapitalization, Microsoft holds approximately 27 percent in the PBC on an as-converted diluted basis. Under the new agreement, OpenAI has contracted to purchase an incremental $250 billion of Azure services, and Microsoft will no longer have a right of first refusal to be OpenAI's compute provider.
